responsibility: Defines the RX backend’s RTL predicates used by the machine description to classify operands and recognize multi-instruction RTL forms. Besides simple call, shift, comparison, memory, and source-operand predicates, it implements special predicates for stack-oriented parallel patterns such as pushm/popm/load-multiple and rtsd sequences, giving rx.md precise match logic for legal RX operands and compound prologue/epilogue-style insns.
